```text
| Decision | Add a `lockedCollaboratorIds` set to AppState next to #116's `hiddenCollaboratorIds` (never persisted, exported, or synced), and enforce "hidden implies locked" in one pure function in `element/ownership.ts`. |

| Rationale | Reuses #116's existing state structure and leaves its tests untouched. Alternative 1 is safer by design but means reworking #116's state and tests for little extra benefit, since one central function already enforces the rule. Alternative 2 is rejected: `locked` is stored on the element itself, so it syncs to every collaborator and would break Criteria F. |
| Consequences | Two sets must stay consistent, so the "hidden implies locked" rule lives in one function with its own unit tests. A later refactor to a single per-collaborator state stays possible. |
```

```text
Closes #80 (Sub-issue)

## What changed

Implemented local client-side visibility controls for collaborators' drawings, ensuring users can independently show or hide individual, all, or none of their peers' drawings without affecting shared scene data, sync status, or other clients' views.

### Ownership & Identity (`excalidraw-app`)
- Implemented a one-time `customData.creatorId` stamp applied by the client that first introduces an element to the room (ensuring edits never transfer ownership, and pastes or duplicates belong to the paster).
- Added a robust per-tab client ID system utilizing a `localStorage` pool, Web Locks, and `sessionStorage` to allow reopened tabs to correctly reclaim their ID.
- Introduced non-volatile `USER_IDENTITY` messaging on join, new-user creation, and renames, with optional `clientId` support added to pointer and idle payloads while maintaining compatibility with older clients.
- Implemented a locally persisted, per-room "previously seen" collaborator directory.

### Editor & UI Architecture (`packages`)
- Extended `AppState` with `hiddenCollaboratorIds`, `collaboratorDirectory`, and `viewModeBeforeSelfHide` (configured to never be persisted, exported, or synced).
- Established a single centralized visibility rule (`element/ownership.ts`) consumed across rendering, hit-testing, selection/binding chokepoints, the eraser tool, search, and exports.
- Configured hidden elements so they cannot be selected, erased, bound to, or exported (while preserving existing bindings), routing never-seen creators and untagged elements into a shared miscellaneous bucket.
- Added toggle, show-all, and hide-all actions, including automatically locking view mode with an explanatory banner when a user hides their own drawings.
- Created the collaborator visibility dropdown menu positioned next to the avatars for both desktop and mobile views.

## Why

Collaborative sessions can quickly become visually cluttered, making it difficult for users to focus on specific work streams or review individual contributions. Providing client-side visibility controls allows users to filter what they see locally without disrupting the shared state, modifying real-time sync, or interfering with what other collaborators view on their own screens.

## Tech Debt

**Introduced:** Added an extra redundant guard at the selection and deletion chokepoints that explicitly validates collaborator visibility before applying destructive scene operations. While strictly redundant with the internal state checks in `element/ownership.ts`, this additional failsafe intentionally compromises pure architectural separation to guarantee that hidden peer elements can never be accidentally selected, mutated, or permanently erased during bulk operations. This can be removed in the future if internal safe-guards are considered enough, or until architectural design is modified in a way to properly encompass a failsafe pathway.

**Encountered:** None. Implementation of this was built from scratch. Because of this, no test cases existed and had to be made.

## Notes

- Added 129 comprehensive feature tests covering multi-client collaboration flows through the real Collab/Portal, complete with control cases and mutation checks.
- All existing tests pass, and typecheck, lint, and Prettier checks are clean.

## Review

PR requires review from teammate.
```

```text
Implement Per-User Visible-Only Toggle
OPEN
# Issue Description

## Summary

**Carryover from #80.** #80 asked for per-collaborator visibility *and* interactivity controls. PR #116 implemented visibility (ownership tracking, the central visibility rule, and the collaborator dropdown) but not interactivity. This issue completes #80's remaining interactivity criteria.

It adds a **visible-only (locked)** mode. A collaborator's drawings stay visible on my screen, but I can't select, edit, move, resize, erase, bind to, or delete them. Hidden collaborators are always non-interactive. All of this is local to my client: shared scene data and other collaborators are unaffected.

## User Story

**As a** collaborator in a shared session, **I want** to lock other collaborators' drawings on my own screen while still seeing them, **so that** I can use their work as a reference without accidentally changing it.

## User Scenario

A user is in a collaborative Excalidraw room with several teammates. They want to trace around a teammate's diagram without accidentally moving it. They open the existing collaborator dropdown and lock that teammate. The teammate's drawings stay visible, but clicking, dragging, or marquee-selecting over them has no effect, so the user can draw on top freely. Later they unlock the teammate and can edit their drawings again. The teammate and everyone else in the room notice nothing.

---

# Issue Classification

## Scope

**Generic:** Small

**Specific:** Small (3 points)

**Reason:** Carryover of #80's interactivity criteria. #116 already provides element ownership (`customData.creatorId`), the central visibility rule (`element/ownership.ts`) used by rendering, hit-testing, selection, eraser, and binding, and the collaborator dropdown with per-collaborator and show-all/hide-all actions. This issue adds one more local state per collaborator, checks it at those same existing points, and adds a lock toggle plus lock-all/unlock-all to the existing dropdown. No new UI layout, no new ownership logic, no sync changes.

---

# Expectations

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Criteria A: Per-collaborator lock toggle.** Each collaborator in the existing dropdown (including the "unknown / miscellaneous" bucket) has a lock toggle next to their visibility toggle. Locking makes their drawings visible but non-interactive on my client; unlocking makes them interactive again.
- [ ] **Criteria B: Bulk lock controls.** The dropdown has "Lock all" and "Unlock all" actions. "Lock all" locks every listed collaborator. "Unlock all" unlocks every *visible* collaborator; hidden collaborators stay non-interactive.
- [ ] **Criteria C: No interactivity without visibility.** While a collaborator is hidden, their lock toggle shows as locked and can't be changed. When they are made visible again, they stay locked until I unlock them.
- [ ] **Criteria D: Locked elements can't be selected.** A locked collaborator's elements are never selected by clicking, marquee/box selection, or Select All (Ctrl/Cmd+A). A marquee over a mix of locked and unlocked elements selects only the unlocked ones. Clicking a locked element behaves like clicking empty canvas, or selects an unlocked element underneath it if there is one.
- [ ] **Criteria E: Locked elements can't be changed.** From my client, a locked collaborator's elements can't be moved, resized, rotated, deleted, erased with the eraser tool, text-edited by double-click, or used as a binding target for arrows.
- [ ] **Criteria F: Shared-state integrity.** Locking or unlocking changes no element in the scene (element versions stay the same) and sends nothing new to other collaborators. Other collaborators can still see and edit their own and others' drawings as before.
- [ ] **Criteria G: Local and non-persistent.** Lock settings apply only to my client and reset when the page reloads, matching the existing visibility settings from #116.
- [ ] **Criteria H: My own drawings are not affected.** My own elements are not in the lock list and always stay interactive.

## Resolved Questions

- **How are elements tied to collaborators?** Through `customData.creatorId` from #116. Elements with no known creator belong to the existing "unknown / miscellaneous" bucket, which can be locked like any collaborator.
- **How does the UI handle trying to enable interactivity on a hidden collaborator?** The lock toggle is disabled while the collaborator is hidden (Criteria C).
- **How does marquee selection treat locked elements?** It skips them and still selects unlocked elements in the same area (Criteria D).
- **Do settings persist?** No. They reset on reload, the same as visibility in #116 (Criteria G).

---

# Extra

## Out of Scope

- Changes to visibility behavior, ownership tracking, or the dropdown layout from #116.
- Preventing other collaborators from editing anything on their own clients (server-side authorization or write locks).
- Undo/redo of edits I made to a collaborator's elements *before* locking them.
- Persisting lock settings across reloads or rooms.
- Changing z-order or layering based on collaborator.

## Related

- **Carryover from:** #80 (closed by #116, which delivered visibility only)
- **Depends on:** #116 (merged)
- **Design decisions:** see the Design comment below

## Head Issue

Issue (#14): Allow a togglable Layer in which all users are compartmentalized by interactivity and visibility.
```

```text
b4940e30 Merge pull request #151 from CSCI-435-SE/docs/showcase2
import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { isBoundToContainer } from "./typeChecks";

import type { ElementsMap, ExcalidrawElement } from "./types";

/** `customData` key holding the id of the client that created the element */
export const CREATOR_ID_KEY = "creatorId";

/** bucket for elements without (valid) creator metadata, e.g. legacy rooms */
export const UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID = "__unknown__";

const getStampedCreatorId = (element: ExcalidrawElement): string | null => {
  const creatorId = element.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY];
  return typeof creatorId === "string" && creatorId ? creatorId : null;
};

/**
 * Returns the id of the client that created the element, or
 * `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` if it isn't known.
 *
 * Bound text follows its container so labels never show/hide separately
 * from the shape they belong to.
 */
export const getElementCreatorId = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
): string => {
  const owner = isBoundToContainer(element)
    ? elementsMap.get(element.containerId) ?? element
    : element;

  return getStampedCreatorId(owner) ?? UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID;
};

/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CreatorVisibility = {
  /**
   * creator ids hidden on this client. `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` hides the
   * miscellaneous bucket.
   */
  hiddenCollaboratorIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /**
   * creators this client can name (seen at some point). Stamped creators
   * missing from it are treated as unknown (miscellaneous). `null`/omitted
   * (e.g. outside of a room) â†’ every stamped creator is its own bucket.
   */
  collaboratorDirectory?: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown> | null;
};

/**
 * The visibility bucket an element belongs to: its creator, or
 * `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` for untagged elements and creators this client has
 * never seen.
 */
export const getElementVisibilityBucket = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  collaboratorDirectory: CreatorVisibility["collaboratorDirectory"],
): string => {
  const creatorId = getElementCreatorId(element, elementsMap);
  if (
    collaboratorDirectory &&
    creatorId !== UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID &&
    !collaboratorDirectory.has(creatorId)
  ) {
    return UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID;
  }
  return creatorId;
};

/**
 * Whether the element's visibility bucket is hidden.
 *
 * Element-level counterpart of the editor's `isElementHiddenLocally`, so
 * element logic (selection, binding) can exclude hidden collaborators'
 * elements without depending on the editor package.
 */
export const isElementByHiddenCreator = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  { hiddenCollaboratorIds, collaboratorDirectory }: CreatorVisibility,
): boolean => {
  if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size) {
    return false;
  }
  return hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(
    getElementVisibilityBucket(element, elementsMap, collaboratorDirectory),
  );
};

/**
 * Filters out elements whose visibility bucket is hidden. Returns the input
 * array as-is when nothing is hidden.
 *
 * @param elementsMap used to resolve bound text containers. Defaults to a map
 * of `elements`, so pass the full scene map when `elements` is a subset.
 */
export const excludeElementsByHiddenCreators = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  visibility: CreatorVisibility,
  elementsMap?: ElementsMap,
): readonly T[] => {
  if (!visibility.hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size) {
    return elements;
  }
  const map = elementsMap ?? arrayToMap(elements);
  return elements.filter(
    (element) => !isElementByHiddenCreator(element, map, visibility),
  );
};
```

```text
36	 * @param elementsMap used to resolve bound text containers. Defaults to

39	export const getLocallyVisibleElements = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
40	  elements: readonly T[],
41	  appState: LocalVisibilityState,

46	/**
47	 * Selection safety net: hidden elements must never stay selected, otherwise
48	 * actions (delete, ungroup, move…) would modify them for every collaborator.
49	 *
50	 * Returns the selection-related appState to apply, or `null` if the
51	 * selection contains no hidden elements.
52	 */
53	export const getSelectionWithoutHiddenElements = (
54	  appState: LocalVisibilityState &
55	    Pick<
56	      AppState,
57	      "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "selectedLinearElement"
58	    >,
59	  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
60	): Pick<
61	  AppState,
62	  "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "selectedLinearElement"
63	> | null => {
64	  if (!appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size) {
65	    return null;
66	  }
67
68	  const isHidden = (id: string) => {
69	    const element = elementsMap.get(id);
70	    return !!element && isElementHiddenLocally(element, elementsMap, appState);
71	  };
72
73	  const hiddenSelectedIds = Object.keys(appState.selectedElementIds).filter(
74	    isHidden,
75	  );
76	  // a group containing hidden members can't stay selected as a group, or
77	  // group actions (ungroup, group bbox…) would reach the hidden members
78	  const groupIdsWithHiddenMembers = Object.keys(
79	    appState.selectedGroupIds,
80	  ).filter((groupId) =>
81	    getElementsInGroup(elementsMap, groupId).some((el) => isHidden(el.id)),
82	  );
83	  const isLinearElementHidden =
84	    !!appState.selectedLinearElement &&
85	    isHidden(appState.selectedLinearElement.elementId);
86
87	  if (
88	    !hiddenSelectedIds.length &&
89	    !groupIdsWithHiddenMembers.length &&
90	    !isLinearElementHidden
91	  ) {
92	    return null;
93	  }
94
95	  const selectedElementIds = { ...appState.selectedElementIds };
96	  for (const id of hiddenSelectedIds) {
97	    delete selectedElementIds[id];
98	  }
99
100	  const selectedGroupIds = { ...appState.selectedGroupIds };
101	  for (const groupId of groupIdsWithHiddenMembers) {
102	    delete selectedGroupIds[groupId];
103	  }
104
105	  return {
106	    selectedElementIds,
107	    selectedGroupIds,
108	    selectedLinearElement: isLinearElementHidden
109	      ? null
110	      : appState.selectedLinearElement,
111	  };
112	};

142	export const getVisibilityBuckets = (
143	  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
144	  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory">,
145	): Set<string> => {
146	  const buckets = new Set<string>([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
147
148	  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
149	    if (collaborator.id) {
150	      buckets.add(collaborator.id);
151	    }
152	  }
153	  for (const clientId of appState.collaboratorDirectory?.keys() ?? []) {
154	    buckets.add(clientId);
155	  }
156
157	  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
158	  for (const element of elements) {
159	    if (!element.isDeleted) {
160	      buckets.add(
161	        getElementVisibilityBucket(
162	          element,
163	          elementsMap,
164	          appState.collaboratorDirectory,
165	        ),
166	      );
167	    }
168	  }
169
170	  return buckets;
171	};

173	export type CollaboratorVisibilityRow = {
174	  /** visibility bucket id (client id, or UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID) */
175	  id: string;
176	  username: string | null;
177	  isCurrentUser: boolean;
178	  isHidden: boolean;
179	  /** non-deleted elements in this bucket (bound text counts with its shape) */
180	  drawingsCount: number;
181	  avatarUrl?: string;
182	};
183
184	export type CollaboratorVisibilityRows = {
185	  inRoom: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
186	  previouslySeen: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
187	  miscellaneous: CollaboratorVisibilityRow;
188	};
189
190	/**
191	 * Rows for the collaborator visibility menu:
192	 * - in the room: live collaborators (you first)
193	 * - previously seen: directory entries no longer live (most recent first)
194	 * - miscellaneous: untagged elements + creators this client never saw
195	 */
196	export const getCollaboratorVisibilityRows = (
197	  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
198	  appState: Pick<
199	    AppState,
200	    "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds"
201	  >,
202	): CollaboratorVisibilityRows => {
203	  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
204	  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
205	  for (const element of elements) {
206	    if (
207	      element.isDeleted ||
208	      // labels count as part of their shape
209	      (element.type === "text" && element.containerId)
210	    ) {
211	      continue;
212	    }
213	    const bucket = getElementVisibilityBucket(
214	      element,
215	      elementsMap,
216	      appState.collaboratorDirectory,
217	    );
218	    counts.set(bucket, (counts.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);
219	  }
220
221	  const toRow = (
222	    id: string,
223	    username: string | null,
224	    extra?: Partial<CollaboratorVisibilityRow>,
225	  ): CollaboratorVisibilityRow => ({
226	    id,
227	    username,
228	    isCurrentUser: false,
229	    isHidden: appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(id),
230	    drawingsCount: counts.get(id) ?? 0,
231	    ...extra,
232	  });
233
234	  const inRoom = new Map<string, CollaboratorVisibilityRow>();
235	  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
236	    // several tabs can't share an id, but guard against duplicates anyway
237	    if (collaborator.id && !inRoom.has(collaborator.id)) {
238	      inRoom.set(
239	        collaborator.id,
240	        toRow(
241	          collaborator.id,
242	          collaborator.username ??
243	            appState.collaboratorDirectory?.get(collaborator.id)?.username ??
244	            null,
245	          {
246	            isCurrentUser: !!collaborator.isCurrentUser,
247	            avatarUrl: collaborator.avatarUrl,
248	          },
249	        ),
250	      );
251	    }
252	  }
253
254	  const previouslySeen = [...(appState.collaboratorDirectory ?? [])]
255	    .filter(([id]) => !inRoom.has(id))
256	    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.lastSeen - a.lastSeen)
257	    .map(([id, entry]) => toRow(id, entry.username));
258
259	  return {
260	    inRoom: [...inRoom.values()].sort(
261	      (a, b) =>
262	        Number(b.isCurrentUser) - Number(a.isCurrentUser) ||
263	        (a.username ?? "").localeCompare(b.username ?? ""),
264	    ),
265	    previouslySeen,
266	    miscellaneous: toRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, null),
267	  };
268	};
```

# Checkpoint 1: Recon

**Setup:** I fast-forwarded local master to `origin/master` (`b4940e30`) and created `feat/collaborator-lock` from it. I made no file edits. The untracked `docs/showcase2/README.md` came along from the previous branch; I'm leaving it alone and won't commit it.

## 1. How `hiddenCollaboratorIds` flows

**State**

- Type: [types.ts:574](packages/excalidraw/types.ts#L574)
- Default `new Set()`: [appState.ts:140](packages/excalidraw/appState.ts#L140)
- Never persisted, exported or synced (all three storage flags false): [appState.ts:288](packages/excalidraw/appState.ts#L288)

**Actions** in [actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts](packages/excalidraw/actions/actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts):

- toggle: lines 15–35
- show all: lines 37–50
- hide all: lines 53–68, which uses `getVisibilityBuckets` from [visibility.ts:142](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts#L142)
- All three use `CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER`, so nothing goes into history or the sync store.

**The central rule** in [ownership.ts](packages/element/src/ownership.ts):

- `getElementVisibilityBucket` (:57) maps each element to its bucket. Bound text follows its container, and creators that aren't in the directory count as `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID`.
- `isElementByHiddenCreator` (:79) is the check itself.
- `excludeElementsByHiddenCreators` (:99) is the filter version.
- The editor wraps them in [visibility.ts:26](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts#L26) (`isElementHiddenLocally`) and [visibility.ts:39](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts#L39) (`getLocallyVisibleElements`).

**Chokepoints that consume it**

| Kind | Location |
| --- | --- |
| Render | [Renderer.ts:116](packages/excalidraw/scene/Renderer.ts#L116); embeddables [App.tsx:1705](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L1705); frame names [App.tsx:2076](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L2076) |
| Hit test | [App.tsx:6625](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L6625) `getElementsAtPosition`; [App.tsx:6739](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L6739) `getTextBindableContainerAtPosition` |
| Selection | [groups.ts:191-209](packages/element/src/groups.ts#L191-L209) `selectGroupsForSelectedElements`; safety net [App.tsx:3667-3681](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L3667-L3681) using [visibility.ts:53](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts#L53) |
| Binding | [binding.ts:622](packages/element/src/binding.ts#L622); [focus.ts:243](packages/element/src/arrows/focus.ts#L243); [App.tsx:6592](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L6592) `getBindableElements` |
| Eraser | [eraser/index.ts:102](packages/excalidraw/eraser/index.ts#L102) (uses `app.visibleElements`); group members at [:167](packages/excalidraw/eraser/index.ts#L167) |
| Other | frame under cursor [App.tsx:7565](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L7565); path-target pick [App.tsx:10525](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L10525); export [data/index.ts:61](packages/excalidraw/data/index.ts#L61); search ([SearchMenu.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/SearchMenu.tsx), [LayerUI.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/LayerUI.tsx)); self-hide view-mode lock [App.tsx:3686](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L3686) |

## 2. Criteria D/E interactions

| Interaction | Path | Does it reach the rule today? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Click select | `getElementsAtPosition` [App.tsx:6625](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L6625) | Yes. Swap the filter to the lock rule. A locked element then counts as a miss, so the click falls through to whatever is underneath, which is what D asks for. |
| Marquee | [App.tsx:11667](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L11667) → `selectGroupsForSelectedElements` | Yes, via [groups.ts:191](packages/element/src/groups.ts#L191). |
| Lasso | [lasso/index.ts:133](packages/excalidraw/lasso/index.ts#L133) → same function | Yes, via groups.ts. |
| Ctrl/Cmd+A | [actionSelectAll.ts:47](packages/excalidraw/actions/actionSelectAll.ts#L47) → same function | Yes, via groups.ts. |

## The skipped tests in `frame.test.tsx`

They aren't ours, and #116 didn't add them. All 13 skip markers come from one upstream Excalidraw commit: `0f81c302` by David Luzar, 2023-10-25, _"fix: frame add/remove/z-index ordering changes (#7194)"_. They were carried into our fork with the rest of upstream.

**Why 13 markers produce 30 skipped tests:** the two `describe.skip` blocks sit inside a helper called `commonTestCases` ([frame.test.tsx:383](packages/element/tests/frame.test.tsx#L383)). That helper runs twice, once for resizing a frame over elements and once for dragging elements into a frame, so every test inside it is skipped twice.

**Why they're skipped:** commit #7194 changed how frames are layered in z-order when elements are added or removed. The skipped tests check the _old_ behaviour, such as "when frame is in a layer below / above / inner layer" ([:386](packages/element/tests/frame.test.tsx#L386), [:430](packages/element/tests/frame.test.tsx#L430), [:475](packages/element/tests/frame.test.tsx#L475)). After the change they failed, so they were switched off rather than rewritten or deleted. This part is my inference: the commit message doesn't say why, and there's no comment next to the skips.

**Effect on us:** none. They were skipped before #116 and on master today, and I won't touch them. I'll list them under "Encountered" tech debt.

## Arrow binding to locked elements: this conflicts with a fixed AC

Your clarification contradicts **Criteria E** as written in #81: _"a locked collaborator's elements can't be … used as a binding target for arrows."_ Your rules say I stop and ask in this case, so here is the conflict.

**What I understand you want:** I can still attach my arrows to a locked peer's shapes and see that connection, but the locked shape itself must never be moved, resized or snapped by anything I do.

**One technical fact for your decision:** in Excalidraw, binding an arrow also writes the arrow's id into the _target's_ `boundElements` list. That raises the target's version, and the change syncs to everyone. Under your reading this counts as an "addition onto the object", but an automated check that the "locked element's version never changes" would fail once someone binds to it. That's fine as long as the AC and the tests say so explicitly.

**What would change in the plan if you amend E:**

- Binding stays visibility-only, as in #116: hidden elements still can't be bound to, but locked ones can. [binding.ts](packages/element/src/binding.ts), [focus.ts](packages/element/src/arrows/focus.ts) and [App.tsx:6592](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L6592) wouldn't need edits at all. That means fewer files changed and less code for StrykerJS to mutate.
- Everything else in E stays blocked: move, resize, rotate, delete, eraser, and text edit by double-click. Double-click text editing matters most here, because adding a label to a container can resize the container.

**Two decisions I need from you:**

1. **Amending E.** Will you update the AC text in issue #81, so the PR's test evidence matches it? Or should I treat your message as the amendment and quote it in `pr-81.md`? Suggested wording: _"…or text-edited by double-click. Arrows I draw may still bind to locked elements; binding never moves, resizes, or otherwise transforms the locked element."_ I won't edit the issue unless you tell me to.
2. **The reverse direction (my earlier question 3, still open).** Suppose a locked peer's _arrow_ is bound to _my_ shape, and I move my shape. Today the peer's arrow endpoint follows, which moves a locked object. Your rule ("should not force objects to move") suggests it should _not_ follow. But stopping it means breaking or freezing the binding, which then syncs to everyone and distorts their arrow. My recommendation: let it follow (keep #116's behaviour) and record it as a known limitation. Which do you want?

```text
- [ ] **Criteria A: Per-collaborator lock toggle.** Each collaborator in the existing dropdown (including the "unknown / miscellaneous" bucket) has a lock toggle next to their visibility toggle. Locking makes their drawings visible but non-interactive on my client; unlocking makes them interactive again.
- [ ] **Criteria B: Bulk lock controls.** The dropdown has "Lock all" and "Unlock all" actions. "Lock all" locks every listed collaborator. "Unlock all" unlocks every *visible* collaborator; hidden collaborators stay non-interactive.

- [ ] **Criteria D: Locked elements can't be selected.** A locked collaborator's elements are never selected by clicking, marquee/box selection, or Select All (Ctrl/Cmd+A). A marquee over a mix of locked and unlocked elements selects only the unlocked ones. Clicking a locked element behaves like clicking empty canvas, or selects an unlocked element underneath it if there is one.
- [ ] **Criteria E: Locked elements can't be changed.** From my client, a locked collaborator's elements can't be moved, resized, rotated, deleted, erased with the eraser tool, or text-edited by double-click.
- [ ] **Criteria F: Shared-state integrity.** Locking or unlocking changes no element in the scene (element versions stay the same) and sends nothing new to other collaborators. Other collaborators can still see and edit their own and others' drawings as before.
- [ ] **Criteria G: Local and non-persistent.** Lock settings apply only to my client and reset when the page reloads, matching the existing visibility settings from #116.
- [ ] **Criteria H: My own drawings are not affected.** My own elements are not in the lock list and always stay interactive.
- **How does the UI handle trying to enable interactivity on a hidden collaborator?** The lock toggle is disabled while the collaborator is hidden (Criteria C).
- **How does marquee selection treat locked elements?** It skips them and still selects unlocked elements in the same area (Criteria D).
```

## Your note: interactivity always depends on visibility

That matches the design, and here is how the code will enforce it:

- **The rule:** `ownership.ts` gets a single pure function that answers "can I interact with this bucket?": **not hidden AND not locked**. Hidden always wins, so even if `lockedCollaboratorIds` somehow got out of sync with `hiddenCollaboratorIds`, a hidden collaborator still can't be edited. The rule itself enforces "no interaction without visibility"; the two sets don't have to stay perfectly in step for it to hold.
- **Where each check is used:**
  - Interaction points (selection, hit test, eraser, text edit, the selection safety net) call only the interactivity check, which already includes visibility. They never check visibility and locking separately.
  - Visibility points (rendering, export, search) and **binding** call only the visibility check.
  - So no single location checks "locked" without visibility also being covered.
- **Tests:** the rule gets its own unit tests in `ownership.test.ts`. These cover hidden plus not locked (non-interactive), locked plus visible, neither, and both, each labelled with the AC it checks.

The plan loses three files: [binding.ts](packages/element/src/binding.ts), [focus.ts](packages/element/src/arrows/focus.ts) and [App.tsx:6592](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L6592) no longer change. That also means less code for StrykerJS to mutate.

## Still open before Checkpoint 2

1. **Where the "stay locked after being shown again" rule lives (C).** My recommendation is that hiding someone also adds them to the locked set, through one pure helper called from #116's toggle and Hide all actions. It's about one line in each action, and #116's tests stay unchanged.
2. **H vs. hiding yourself.** You're never in the lock list. The lock toggle on your own row is disabled and shown unlocked, and Lock all skips you. #116's self-hide view mode stays as it is.
3. **A locked peer's arrow bound to _my_ shape.** Under amended E, binding is outside the lock, so when I move my shape their arrow's endpoint follows. I'd record this as a known limitation in the PR.

Reply "continue" if all three defaults are fine, or tell me which to change.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-11 23:51:17Z)**_

I've recorded your rule. Before I start Checkpoint 2 there's one conflict with a fixed AC, so per your rules I'm stopping to ask.

## The conflict with Criteria C

Criteria C says: _"When they are made visible again, they **stay locked until I unlock them**."_

Your rule says that after Hide all → Show all, a collaborator goes back to **unlocked** unless you had locked them before Hide all. For anyone you hadn't locked before, those two say opposite things.

## How I'd build your rule

The locked set would hold only **locks you set yourself**. The interactivity rule stays "not hidden AND not locked", so hidden still always means non-interactive, without writing anything extra into the locked set.

| You do | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Lock Bob, then Hide all → Show all | Bob is visible and **locked** (your own lock is remembered) |
| Hide all → Show all (Bob was never locked) | Bob is visible and **unlocked** (your rule) |
| Hide Bob with his own eye toggle → show him again | Bob is visible and **locked**, as C says, until you unlock him |
| Unlock all while Bob is hidden | Bob stays hidden and non-interactive (B). If you had locked Bob yourself, that lock is kept. |

The pure helpers in `ownership.ts` and the action changes stay small: the per-collaborator eye toggle adds the lock when showing someone, and Show all doesn't.

## Questions

1. **Scope:** should the restore apply only to **Show all**, while the per-collaborator eye toggle keeps C's "stay locked" behaviour (what the table shows)? Or should every "show" restore the earlier lock state?
2. **Mixed case:** if Bob was hidden on his own _before_ Hide all, should Show all also unlock him? The table assumes yes, because Show all restores everyone's own locks. Doing it the other way means tracking _how_ each person was hidden, which adds extra state.
3. **AC C text:** please amend C in #81 to match your answers, the same way you did for E, so the tests and the PR evidence line up. A possible wording: _"…When I show them individually, they stay locked until I unlock them. "Show all" restores each collaborator's lock state from before they were hidden."_

**Defaults if you agree:** individual show keeps them locked; Show all restores everyone's own locks; earlier answers 2 (H) and 3 (reverse binding) stand. Once you've updated C, or told me to quote your rule in `pr-81.md` instead, I'll start the Checkpoint 2 tests.

```typescript
/**
 * Issue #81 — per-collaborator lock (visible but non-interactive).
 *
 * State-logic tests for Criteria A, B, C, G, H and the unknown /
 * miscellaneous bucket. Every expected value below is derived from the
 * acceptance criteria in #81, not from running the implementation.
 */
import { CREATOR_ID_KEY, UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import {
  clearAppStateForDatabase,
  clearAppStateForLocalStorage,
  cleanAppStateForExport,
} from "../appState";
import { restoreAppState } from "../data/restore";
import { Excalidraw } from "../index";
import { getCollaboratorVisibilityRows } from "../scene/visibility";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { act, render, unmountComponent } from "./test-utils";

import type { ActionName } from "../actions/types";
import type { AppState } from "../types";

unmountComponent();

const h = window.h;

const stamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, creatorId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  }) as T;

const createRect = (id: string, x: number) =>
  API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id, x, y: 0, width: 10 });

/**
 * Runs a registered action by name. Looking actions up in the registry
 * (instead of importing them) makes a not-yet-implemented action fail as a
 * readable assertion rather than as a broken import.
 */
const execute = (name: string, value?: string) => {
  const action = h.app.actionManager.actions[name as ActionName];
  expect(action, `action "${name}" should be registered`).toBeDefined();
  act(() => {
    h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value as any);
  });
};

const lockedIds = () => {
  expect(h.state.lockedCollaboratorIds).toBeInstanceOf(Set);
  return [...h.state.lockedCollaboratorIds].sort();
};

const hiddenIds = () => [...h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds].sort();

/** every row the dropdown lists, keyed by bucket id */
const getRows = () => {
  const rows = getCollaboratorVisibilityRows(h.elements, h.state);
  return new Map(
    [...rows.inRoom, ...rows.previouslySeen, rows.miscellaneous].map((row) => [
      row.id,
      row,
    ]),
  );
};

const getRow = (id: string) => {
  const row = getRows().get(id);
  expect(row, `row "${id}" should be listed`).toBeDefined();
  return row!;
};

// Session used by every test:
// - me    : this client (in the room)
// - alice : in the room
// - carol : previously seen (in the directory, no longer live)
// - misc  : untagged elements + "dave", a creator this client never saw
const collaborators = new Map([
  ["my-socket", { id: "me", username: "Me", isCurrentUser: true }],
  ["alice-socket", { id: "alice", username: "Alice" }],
]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"];

const collaboratorDirectory = new Map([
  ["me", { username: "Me", lastSeen: 3 }],
  ["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: 3 }],
  ["carol", { username: "Carol", lastSeen: 2 }],
]);

/** the buckets the dropdown lists for this session, other than me */
const OTHERS = ["alice", "carol", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID].sort();

beforeEach(async () => {
  await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
  API.setElements([
    stamp(createRect("me-rect", 0), "me"),
    stamp(createRect("alice-rect", 20), "alice"),
    stamp(createRect("carol-rect", 40), "carol"),
    stamp(createRect("dave-rect", 60), "dave"),
    createRect("legacy-rect", 80),
  ]);
  act(() => {
    h.app.updateScene({ collaborators });
    API.setAppState({ collaboratorDirectory });
  });
});

describe("collaborator lock — Criteria A (per-collaborator toggle)", () => {
  it("AC-A: nobody is locked by default", () => {
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual([]);
    for (const id of ["me", "alice", "carol", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]) {
      expect(getRow(id).isLocked).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("AC-A: toggling a collaborator's lock locks them, toggling again unlocks them", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual(["alice"]);
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(true);

    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual([]);
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-A: locking leaves the collaborator visible", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(hiddenIds()).toEqual([]);
    expect(getRow("alice").isHidden).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-A: locking one collaborator doesn't lock anyone else", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "carol");
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual(["carol"]);
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(false);
    expect(getRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID).isLocked).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-A: a visible collaborator's lock toggle is enabled", () => {
    expect(getRow("alice").isLockDisabled).toBe(false);
    expect(getRow("carol").isLockDisabled).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("collaborator lock — unknown / miscellaneous bucket", () => {
  it("AC-A (misc): the miscellaneous bucket can be locked and unlocked like any collaborator", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID);
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
    expect(getRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID).isLocked).toBe(true);

    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID);
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("AC-A (misc): the miscellaneous row's lock toggle is enabled while visible", () => {
    expect(getRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID).isLockDisabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-B (misc): Lock all includes the miscellaneous bucket", () => {
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    expect(lockedIds()).toContain(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID);
  });

  it("AC-C (misc): hiding the miscellaneous bucket shows it locked and disables its toggle", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID);
    expect(getRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID).isLocked).toBe(true);
    expect(getRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID).isLockDisabled).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("collaborator lock — Criteria B (bulk controls)", () => {
  it("AC-B: Lock all locks every listed collaborator (except me, see AC-H)", () => {
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual(OTHERS);
    for (const id of OTHERS) {
      expect(getRow(id).isLocked).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it("AC-B: Lock all doesn't hide anyone", () => {
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    expect(hiddenIds()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("AC-B: Unlock all unlocks every visible collaborator", () => {
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    execute("unlockAllCollaborators");
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual([]);
    for (const id of OTHERS) {
      expect(getRow(id).isLocked).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("AC-B: Unlock all leaves hidden collaborators non-interactive", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "carol");

    execute("unlockAllCollaborators");

    // alice was visible → unlocked
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(false);
    // carol is hidden → still shown locked (no interactivity without visibility)
    expect(getRow("carol").isLocked).toBe(true);
    expect(getRow("carol").isLockDisabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-B + AC-C: a collaborator hidden during Unlock all is still locked once shown again", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "carol");
    execute("unlockAllCollaborators");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "carol");

    expect(getRow("carol").isHidden).toBe(false);
    expect(getRow("carol").isLocked).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("collaborator lock — Criteria C (no interactivity without visibility)", () => {
  it("AC-C: a hidden collaborator's lock toggle shows locked and is disabled", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(true);
    expect(getRow("alice").isLockDisabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-C: a hidden collaborator can't be unlocked", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");

    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");

    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(true);
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-C: toggling the lock of a hidden, never-locked collaborator changes nothing", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");

    // hiding locked them; the ignored toggle didn't flip that
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-C: shown again individually, a collaborator stays locked until I unlock them", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");

    expect(getRow("alice").isHidden).toBe(false);
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(true);
    expect(getRow("alice").isLockDisabled).toBe(false);

    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-C: after Hide all → Show all, everyone stays locked until I unlock them (except me, see AC-H)", () => {
    execute("hideAllCollaborators");
    execute("showAllCollaborators");

    expect(hiddenIds()).toEqual([]);
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual(OTHERS);
  });

  it("AC-C: showing a collaborator who was locked before hiding keeps them locked", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "carol");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "carol");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "carol");

    expect(getRow("carol").isLocked).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("collaborator lock — Criteria G (local and non-persistent)", () => {
  it("AC-G: lock settings are not saved to local storage", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(clearAppStateForLocalStorage(h.state)).not.toHaveProperty(
      "lockedCollaboratorIds",
    );
  });

  it("AC-G: lock settings are not included in exports", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(cleanAppStateForExport(h.state)).not.toHaveProperty(
      "lockedCollaboratorIds",
    );
  });

  it("AC-G: lock settings are not sent to the server / other collaborators", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(clearAppStateForDatabase(h.state)).not.toHaveProperty(
      "lockedCollaboratorIds",
    );
  });

  it("AC-G: lock settings reset when the page reloads", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");

    // a reload restores app state from what was saved locally
    const saved = clearAppStateForLocalStorage(h.state);
    const restored = restoreAppState(saved, null);

    expect(restored.lockedCollaboratorIds).toBeInstanceOf(Set);
    expect(restored.lockedCollaboratorIds.size).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe("collaborator lock — Criteria H (my own drawings)", () => {
  it("AC-H: I can't lock myself", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "me");
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual([]);
    expect(getRow("me").isLocked).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-H: my own row's lock toggle is disabled and shows unlocked", () => {
    expect(getRow("me").isLocked).toBe(false);
    expect(getRow("me").isLockDisabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-H: Lock all never puts me in the lock list", () => {
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    expect(lockedIds()).not.toContain("me");
    expect(getRow("me").isLocked).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-H: Hide all → Show all never puts me in the lock list", () => {
    execute("hideAllCollaborators");
    execute("showAllCollaborators");
    expect(lockedIds()).not.toContain("me");
    expect(getRow("me").isLocked).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-H: a lock list set from outside never makes my row locked", () => {
    act(() => {
      API.setAppState({ lockedCollaboratorIds: new Set(["me"]) });
    });
    expect(getRow("me").isLocked).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

# Checkpoint 2: Tests for the state logic (tests only)

**New file:** [collaboratorLock.test.tsx](packages/excalidraw/tests/collaboratorLock.test.tsx), with 29 tests. No source files changed, none of #116's tests changed, and nothing is committed yet; the commit comes at Checkpoint 3.

## Result

```
Test Files  1 failed (1)
     Tests  29 failed (29)
```

## They fail for the right reason

Every failure is an assertion about missing behaviour. None is an import error, `TypeError` or setup error:

| Count | Failure | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 13 | `action "toggleCollaboratorLock" should be registered` | the per-collaborator lock action doesn't exist yet |
| 5 | `action "lockAllCollaborators" should be registered` | the Lock all action doesn't exist yet |
| 1 | `action "unlockAllCollaborators" should be registered` | the Unlock all action doesn't exist yet |
| 3 | `expected undefined to be an instance of Set` | `lockedCollaboratorIds` isn't in AppState yet |
| 4 + 3 | `expected undefined to be false` / `true` | the dropdown rows don't report a lock state yet (`isLocked`, `isLockDisabled`) |

**How I kept this clean:** the tests look actions up by name in the editor's action list rather than importing them. A missing action then fails as a readable assertion instead of a broken import. The same file also uses #116's existing visibility actions, and those calls already work, which shows the test setup itself is sound.

## What the tests check, by criterion

The test session has: **me**; **Alice** (in the room); **Carol** (previously seen); and the miscellaneous bucket (an untagged element plus "Dave", a creator this client has never seen).

| Criterion | Tests | What they check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 5 | Nobody starts locked. Lock and unlock toggle each other. Locking keeps the person visible and affects only them. A visible person's toggle is enabled. |
| Misc bucket | 4 | It can be locked and unlocked, its toggle is enabled, Lock all includes it, and hiding it shows it locked and disabled. |
| B | 5 | Lock all covers everyone listed except me. Lock all hides nobody. Unlock all unlocks everyone visible. A hidden person stays non-interactive through Unlock all and is still locked once shown again. |
| C | 6 | A hidden person shows locked and disabled, and can't be unlocked. After being shown individually, or via Hide all → Show all, they stay locked until I unlock them. |
| G | 4 | Lock settings aren't saved locally, aren't exported, aren't sent to the server, and come back empty after a simulated reload. |
| H | 5 | I can't lock myself. My toggle is disabled and shows unlocked. Neither Lock all nor Hide all → Show all puts me in the list, and setting the list from outside can't make my row locked. |

**Expected values:** every one comes from the AC text, and each test name starts with the AC it checks. For example, `["alice", "carol", misc]` for Lock all is the dropdown's listed rows minus me (B + H).

## These tests fix three names for Checkpoint 3

- **Actions:** `toggleCollaboratorLock`, `lockAllCollaborators`, `unlockAllCollaborators`
- **AppState:** `lockedCollaboratorIds`
- **Dropdown row fields:** `isLocked` (shown locked, so true whenever the person is hidden) and `isLockDisabled` (true when the person is hidden, or the row is mine)

## Notes

- `yarn test:typecheck` will report errors in this file until Checkpoint 3 adds the new fields. That's expected while the behaviour doesn't exist yet.
- The run command for the relevant tests is now the baseline list plus this file.

## Tech debt (running list)

- **Encountered:** `frame.test.tsx` has 30 upstream skipped tests.
- **Encountered:** `getLocallyVisibleElements` is shared by export and the bindable-element list. With amended E this no longer affects #81, but the mix-up remains.
- **Encountered:** #116's dropdown row is a single `<button>`, so it has to be restructured at Checkpoint 5.
- **Introduced:** the tests look actions up by name as a string, so a renamed action would only be caught when the tests run, not by the typecheck. This keeps the failures readable before the actions exist; I can switch to direct imports at Checkpoint 3 if you prefer.

You said you'd like a line-by-line walkthrough of the tests after you test manually. That's ready whenever you are. Waiting for "continue" to start Checkpoint 3.

<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```typescript
import {
  CaptureUpdateAction,
  addLockedCollaborators,
  toggleLockedCollaborator,
  unlockVisibleCollaborators,
} from "@excalidraw/element";

import {
  eyeClosedIcon,
  eyeIcon,
  LockedIcon,
  UnlockedIcon,
} from "../components/icons";
import {
  getSelfCollaboratorId,
  getVisibilityBuckets,
} from "../scene/visibility";

import { register } from "./register";

/*
 * Local-only visibility of collaborators' drawings. These only change
 * `appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds` (never synced, never in history); hiding
 * your own drawings locks view mode (enforced in App.componentDidUpdate).
 *
 * Hiding a collaborator also locks them (#81), so they stay non-interactive
 * once shown again, until unlocked.
 */

/** toggles one visibility bucket (a creator id, or UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID) */
export const actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility = register<string>({
  name: "toggleCollaboratorVisibility",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.toggle",
  icon: eyeIcon,
  // must work in view mode: it's how you get out of the self-hide lock
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState, bucketId) {
    if (!bucketId) {
      return false;
    }
    const hiddenCollaboratorIds = new Set(appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds);
    let { lockedCollaboratorIds } = appState;
    if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds.delete(bucketId)) {
      hiddenCollaboratorIds.add(bucketId);
      lockedCollaboratorIds = addLockedCollaborators(
        lockedCollaboratorIds,
        [bucketId],
        getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
      );
    }
    return {
      appState: { ...appState, hiddenCollaboratorIds, lockedCollaboratorIds },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

export const actionShowAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "showAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.showAll",
  icon: eyeIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: { ...appState, hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set() },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
  predicate: (elements, appState) => appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size > 0,
});

/** hides everyone, including yourself (which locks view mode) */
export const actionHideAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "hideAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.hideAll",
  icon: eyeClosedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    const hiddenCollaboratorIds = getVisibilityBuckets(elements, appState);
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        hiddenCollaboratorIds,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: addLockedCollaborators(
          appState.lockedCollaboratorIds,
          hiddenCollaboratorIds,
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

/*
 * Local-only locking (#81): locked collaborators' drawings stay visible but
 * are non-interactive. These only change `appState.lockedCollaboratorIds`
 * (never synced, never in history). The rules live in `element/ownership.ts`.
 */

/** toggles one bucket's lock (ignored while hidden, and for yourself) */
export const actionToggleCollaboratorLock = register<string>({
  name: "toggleCollaboratorLock",
  label: "collaboratorLock.toggle",
  icon: LockedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState, bucketId) {
    if (!bucketId) {
      return false;
    }
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: toggleLockedCollaborator(
          appState,
          bucketId,
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

/** locks every listed bucket except yourself */
export const actionLockAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "lockAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorLock.lockAll",
  icon: LockedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: addLockedCollaborators(
          appState.lockedCollaboratorIds,
          getVisibilityBuckets(elements, appState),
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

/** unlocks every visible bucket; hidden ones stay locked */
export const actionUnlockAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "unlockAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorLock.unlockAll",
  icon: UnlockedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: unlockVisibleCollaborators(
          appState,
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});
```

# Checkpoint 3: State logic implemented and committed

**Commit:** `78523efe` on `feat/collaborator-lock`, authored by CashenCroft, ending with the Co-Authored-By line. 13 files changed. Nothing was pushed, and your untracked `docs/showcase2/README.md` stayed out of the commit.

## Results

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Relevant suites (the 6 baseline files plus `collaboratorLock.test.tsx`) | **Test Files 7 passed (7) · Tests 154 passed \| 30 skipped (184)**. That's the 125 baseline tests plus the 29 new ones. |
| Full suite (`yarn test:update`) | **Test Files 143 passed (143) · Tests 2179 passed \| 47 skipped \| 1 todo**, with 133 snapshots updated |
| Typecheck | clean (exit 0) |
| ESLint on the changed source files | clean |

## What changed

**The rule:** [ownership.ts](packages/element/src/ownership.ts) holds all the lock logic as pure functions.

- `isCollaboratorInteractive`: hidden means never interactive; my own bucket is always interactive; otherwise a bucket is interactive unless locked. The dropdown rows already use it, and Checkpoint 4 will call the same function at every interaction point.
- `addLockedCollaborators`, `toggleLockedCollaborator` and `unlockVisibleCollaborators` work out the new lock list. They never add me (H) and never change a hidden person's lock (C).

**State:** [types.ts](packages/excalidraw/types.ts) and [appState.ts](packages/excalidraw/appState.ts) add `lockedCollaboratorIds`, default empty and never persisted, exported or synced. A reload falls back to the empty default automatically (G).

**Actions:** [actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts](packages/excalidraw/actions/actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts) adds `toggleCollaboratorLock`, `lockAllCollaborators` and `unlockAllCollaborators`. None of them add undo history or anything to sync.

**Rows:** [visibility.ts](packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts) gives each dropdown row `isLocked` and `isLockDisabled`.

**Labels:** [en.json](packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json) adds the three action labels.

## Changes to #116 code (you asked to be told)

- **#116's toggle and Hide all actions** each gained one call: hiding someone now also adds them to the lock list (C). Show all is unchanged.
- **#116's row function** gained the two new fields. Its parameter type accepts the lock list as _optional_, so #116's row tests compile unchanged.
- **#116's tests:** not modified.
- **Snapshots:** the 133 updates add only `"lockedCollaboratorIds": Set {}` lines, which I checked by diffing for any other changed line. #116 updated the same four snapshot files the same way.
- **Export snapshot:** one of those lines is in `export.test.ts.snap`. That snapshot records the in-memory state handed to the SVG renderer, not exported file content; `hiddenCollaboratorIds` sits there the same way.

## Process notes

- **My mistake, no harm done:** I ran `yarn prettier --write <files>`, but this repo's `prettier` script already includes `.`, so it processed the whole repo. I checked afterwards: no tracked file outside mine changed, and your untracked README still has its Nov 9 timestamp. From now on I'll run prettier on specific files only.
- **Test fix:** I swapped two test assertions to vitest's `assert`, because the repo's `expect` types don't accept a message argument. The checks are the same.

## Tech debt (running list)

- **Introduced:** the tests look actions up by name as a string, so a renamed action would only be caught when the tests run, not by the typecheck.
- **Introduced:** the rule functions are so far tested only indirectly, through the actions and rows. Checkpoint 4 adds direct unit tests in `ownership.test.ts`, which you'll want for StrykerJS.
- **Encountered:** the repo's `yarn prettier` script can't be scoped to specific files.
- **Encountered:** `frame.test.tsx` has 30 upstream skipped tests; `getLocallyVisibleElements` is shared by export and the bindable-element list; and #116's dropdown row is a single `<button>`.

This slice is ready for a PR if you want one. If you do, tell me and I'll open it; I won't push or open one otherwise. Waiting for "continue" to start Checkpoint 4 (enforcement).

```typescript
/**
 * Issue #81 — unit tests for the pure interactivity rule and lock-list
 * transitions in `ownership.ts`. Expected values come from the acceptance
 * criteria in #81:
 *
 * - C: no interactivity without visibility (hidden → never interactive)
 * - H: my own drawings are never locked and always stay interactive
 * - A/B: locking / unlocking a bucket, Lock all, Unlock all
 */
import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { newElement, newTextElement } from "../newElement";
import {
  CREATOR_ID_KEY,
  UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
  addLockedCollaborators,
  excludeNonInteractiveElements,
  getSelfCreatorId,
  isCollaboratorInteractive,
  isElementInteractive,
  toggleLockedCollaborator,
  unlockVisibleCollaborators,
} from "../ownership";

const createRect = (creatorId?: string) =>
  newElement({
    type: "rectangle",
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    customData:
      creatorId === undefined ? undefined : { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  });

const sets = (hidden: string[] = [], locked: string[] = []) => ({
  hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set(hidden),
  lockedCollaboratorIds: new Set(locked),
});

/** `collaborators` as the editor stores them, with "me" as the current user */
const collaborators = new Map([
  ["my-socket", { id: "me", isCurrentUser: true }],
  ["alice-socket", { id: "alice" }],
]);

describe("isCollaboratorInteractive (the interactivity rule)", () => {
  it("AC-A: a bucket that is neither hidden nor locked is interactive", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("alice", sets(), "me")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-A: a locked, visible bucket is not interactive", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("alice", sets([], ["alice"]), "me")).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });

  it("AC-C: a hidden bucket is not interactive even if it isn't locked", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("alice", sets(["alice"]), "me")).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });

  it("AC-C: a hidden and locked bucket is not interactive", () => {
    expect(
      isCollaboratorInteractive("alice", sets(["alice"], ["alice"]), "me"),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-A: locking one bucket doesn't affect another", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("bob", sets([], ["alice"]), "me")).toBe(
      true,
    );
  });

  it("AC-H: my own bucket stays interactive even if it is in the lock list", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("me", sets([], ["me"]), "me")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-C over AC-H: my own hidden bucket is not interactive (no interactivity without visibility)", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("me", sets(["me"]), "me")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-A (misc): the miscellaneous bucket can be locked", () => {
    expect(
      isCollaboratorInteractive(
        UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
        sets([], [UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
        "me",
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-G: with no lock or visibility state (e.g. outside a room) everything is interactive", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("alice", {}, null)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("without a known self id, a locked bucket is still not interactive", () => {
    expect(isCollaboratorInteractive("alice", sets([], ["alice"]), null)).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });
});

describe("addLockedCollaborators", () => {
  it("AC-B: adds every given bucket to the lock list", () => {
    expect(
      [...addLockedCollaborators(new Set(), ["alice", "bob"], "me")].sort(),
    ).toEqual(["alice", "bob"]);
  });

  it("AC-B: keeps buckets that were already locked", () => {
    expect(
      [...addLockedCollaborators(new Set(["carol"]), ["alice"], "me")].sort(),
    ).toEqual(["alice", "carol"]);
  });

  it("AC-H: never adds me", () => {
    expect([
      ...addLockedCollaborators(new Set(), ["me", "alice"], "me"),
    ]).toEqual(["alice"]);
  });

  it("AC-G: doesn't mutate the current lock list (state is replaced, not edited)", () => {
    const locked = new Set(["carol"]);
    addLockedCollaborators(locked, ["alice"], "me");
    expect([...locked]).toEqual(["carol"]);
  });

  it("accepts a missing lock list", () => {
    expect([...addLockedCollaborators(undefined, ["alice"], null)]).toEqual([
      "alice",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("toggleLockedCollaborator", () => {
  it("AC-A: locks an unlocked, visible bucket", () => {
    expect([...toggleLockedCollaborator(sets(), "alice", "me")]).toEqual([
      "alice",
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-A: unlocks a locked, visible bucket", () => {
    expect([
      ...toggleLockedCollaborator(sets([], ["alice"]), "alice", "me"),
    ]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("AC-A: leaves other buckets' locks unchanged", () => {
    expect(
      [...toggleLockedCollaborator(sets([], ["carol"]), "alice", "me")].sort(),
    ).toEqual(["alice", "carol"]);
  });

  it("AC-C: can't unlock a hidden bucket", () => {
    expect([
      ...toggleLockedCollaborator(sets(["alice"], ["alice"]), "alice", "me"),
    ]).toEqual(["alice"]);
  });

  it("AC-C: can't change the lock of a hidden bucket that isn't in the list", () => {
    expect([
      ...toggleLockedCollaborator(sets(["alice"]), "alice", "me"),
    ]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("AC-H: can't lock me", () => {
    expect([...toggleLockedCollaborator(sets(), "me", "me")]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("AC-G: doesn't mutate the current lock list", () => {
    const state = sets([], ["carol"]);
    toggleLockedCollaborator(state, "alice", "me");
    expect([...state.lockedCollaboratorIds]).toEqual(["carol"]);
  });
});

describe("unlockVisibleCollaborators (Unlock all)", () => {
  it("AC-B: unlocks every visible bucket", () => {
    expect([
      ...unlockVisibleCollaborators(sets([], ["alice", "bob"]), "me"),
    ]).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("AC-B + AC-C: hidden buckets stay locked, so they're still locked once shown", () => {
    expect([
      ...unlockVisibleCollaborators(sets(["bob"], ["alice", "bob"]), "me"),
    ]).toEqual(["bob"]);
  });

  it("AC-C: a hidden bucket that wasn't in the lock list ends up locked", () => {
    expect([...unlockVisibleCollaborators(sets(["bob"]), "me")]).toEqual([
      "bob",
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-H: never locks me, even when I'm hidden", () => {
    expect([...unlockVisibleCollaborators(sets(["me"]), "me")]).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("getSelfCreatorId", () => {
  it("AC-H: returns the current user's client id", () => {
    expect(getSelfCreatorId({ collaborators })).toBe("me");
  });

  it("returns null without a current user", () => {
    expect(
      getSelfCreatorId({ collaborators: new Map([["s", { id: "alice" }]]) }),
    ).toBe(null);
  });

  it("returns null when the current user has no client id yet", () => {
    expect(
      getSelfCreatorId({
        collaborators: new Map([["s", { isCurrentUser: true }]]),
      }),
    ).toBe(null);
  });

  it("returns null outside of a room (no collaborators)", () => {
    expect(getSelfCreatorId({})).toBe(null);
  });
});

describe("isElementInteractive", () => {
  const state = (hidden: string[] = [], locked: string[] = []) => ({
    ...sets(hidden, locked),
    collaborators,
  });

  it("AC-D: an element of a locked collaborator is not interactive", () => {
    const rect = createRect("alice");
    expect(
      isElementInteractive(rect, arrayToMap([rect]), state([], ["alice"])),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("(control) an element of an unlocked collaborator is interactive", () => {
    const rect = createRect("alice");
    expect(isElementInteractive(rect, arrayToMap([rect]), state())).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-H: my own element stays interactive even if I'm in the lock list", () => {
    const rect = createRect("me");
    expect(
      isElementInteractive(rect, arrayToMap([rect]), state([], ["me"])),
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it("AC-A (misc): an untagged element follows the miscellaneous bucket's lock", () => {
    const rect = createRect();
    expect(
      isElementInteractive(
        rect,
        arrayToMap([rect]),
        state([], [UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-A (misc): a never-seen creator's element follows the miscellaneous bucket's lock", () => {
    const rect = createRect("dave");
    expect(
      isElementInteractive(rect, arrayToMap([rect]), {
        ...state([], [UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
        collaboratorDirectory: new Map([["alice", {}]]),
      }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it("AC-D: a label follows its container's lock, not its own creator's", () => {
    const container = createRect("alice");
    const label = newTextElement({
      text: "label",
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      containerId: container.id,
      customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: "me" },
    });
    expect(
      isElementInteractive(
        label,
        arrayToMap([container, label]),
        state([], ["alice"]),
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("excludeNonInteractiveElements", () => {
  const me = createRect("me");
  const alice = createRect("alice");
  const bob = createRect("bob");
  const elements = [me, alice, bob];

  it("returns the same array when nobody is hidden or locked", () => {
    expect(
      excludeNonInteractiveElements(elements, { ...sets(), collaborators }),
    ).toBe(elements);
  });

  it("AC-D: drops locked collaborators' elements", () => {
    expect(
      excludeNonInteractiveElements(elements, {
        ...sets([], ["alice"]),
        collaborators,
      }),
    ).toEqual([me, bob]);
  });

  it("AC-C: drops hidden collaborators' elements", () => {
    expect(
      excludeNonInteractiveElements(elements, {
        ...sets(["bob"]),
        collaborators,
      }),
    ).toEqual([me, alice]);
  });

  it("AC-H: keeps my own elements even if I'm in the lock list", () => {
    expect(
      excludeNonInteractiveElements(elements, {
        ...sets([], ["me", "alice", "bob"]),
        collaborators,
      }),
    ).toEqual([me]);
  });
});
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-12 00:10:02Z)**_

A broadcast only goes out when the scene version goes up. So if locking changes no element, nothing can be sent, and that's what the test checks at the socket. Writing it:

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-12 00:10:22Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>

<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```typescript
/**
 * Issue #81 — Criteria F (shared-state integrity) driven through the real
 * Collab/Portal classes. The socket records everything this client sends;
 * encryption is a passthrough. Setup mirrors collabVisibility.test.tsx (#116).
 *
 * AC-F: "Locking or unlocking changes no element in the scene (element
 * versions stay the same) and sends nothing new to other collaborators.
 * Other collaborators can still see and edit their own and others' drawings
 * as before."
 */
import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw";
import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";
import { act, render, waitFor } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/test-utils";
import {
  CREATOR_ID_KEY,
  UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
  newElementWith,
  syncInvalidIndices,
} from "@excalidraw/element";
import { assert, vi } from "vitest";

import type { ActionName } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/actions/types";
import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { WS_EVENTS, WS_SUBTYPES } from "../app_constants";
import ExcalidrawApp from "../App";

import type { SocketUpdateDataSource } from "../data";

const { h } = window;

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  handlers: new Map<string, (...args: any[]) => any>(),
  emitted: [] as any[][],
}));

vi.mock("socket.io-client", () => ({
  default: () => ({
    id: "my-socket",
    on: (event: string, handler: (...args: any[]) => any) => {
      mocks.handlers.set(event, handler);
    },
    once: () => {},
    off: () => {},
    emit: (...args: any[]) => {
      mocks.emitted.push(args);
    },
    close: () => {},
  }),
}));

// all exports mocked explicitly (spreading `importOriginal()` deadlocks the
// app's module initialization, see collabVisibility.test.tsx)
vi.mock("@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/encryption", () => ({
  IV_LENGTH_BYTES: 12,
  createIV: () => new Uint8Array(12),
  getCryptoKey: async () => ({}),
  generateEncryptionKey: async () => "test-room-key",
  encryptData: async (_key: string, data: Uint8Array) => ({
    encryptedBuffer: data,
    iv: new Uint8Array(12),
  }),
  decryptData: async (_iv: Uint8Array, data: ArrayBuffer) => data,
}));

vi.mock("../data/firebase", () => ({
  loadFromFirebase: async () => null,
  saveToFirebase: async () => null,
  isSavedToFirebase: () => true,
  loadFilesFromFirebase: async () => ({ loadedFiles: [], erroredFiles: [] }),
  saveFilesToFirebase: async () => ({
    savedFiles: new Map(),
    erroredFiles: new Map(),
  }),
}));

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const stamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, creatorId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  }) as T;

/** scene updates this client sent to the room (decoded) */
const getSentUpdates = () =>
  mocks.emitted
    .filter(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER)
    .map(([, , buffer]) => JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer)))
    .filter((message) => message.type === WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE);

/** simulates a message from another client arriving through the room */
const deliver = async (
  message: SocketUpdateDataSource[keyof SocketUpdateDataSource],
) => {
  await mocks.handlers.get("client-broadcast")!(
    new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(message)),
    new Uint8Array(12),
  );
};

/** local changes reach Collab through onChange → syncElements */
const sync = () => {
  act(() => {
    window.collab.syncElements(h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted());
  });
};

/** start a new room and finish initialization (we're alone in it) */
const startNewRoom = async () => {
  act(() => {
    window.collab.startCollaboration(null);
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(mocks.handlers.has("first-in-room")).toBe(true));
  await mocks.handlers.get("first-in-room")!();
  await waitFor(() =>
    expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
  );
};

const execute = (name: string, value?: string) => {
  const action = h.app.actionManager.actions[name as ActionName];
  assert.isDefined(action, `action "${name}" should be registered`);
  act(() => {
    h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value as any);
  });
};

const getVersions = () =>
  h.elements.map(({ id, version, versionNonce }) => ({
    id,
    version,
    versionNonce,
  }));

const getElement = (id: string) => h.elements.find((el) => el.id === id)!;

/** a peer's element arrives in the room */
const receivePeerElement = async () => {
  await deliver({
    type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
    payload: {
      elements: syncInvalidIndices([
        stamp(API.createElement({ id: "theirs", x: 0 }), "alice"),
      ]),
    },
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(getElement("theirs")).toBeDefined());
};

describe("collaborator lock (collaboration) — Criteria F", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    mocks.handlers.clear();
    mocks.emitted.length = 0;
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
    // a previous test's room link would make the app auto-join that room
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", window.location.origin);
    await render(<ExcalidrawApp />);
    await startNewRoom();
    await receivePeerElement();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it("(control) a local edit is sent to the room", () => {
    const sentBefore = getSentUpdates().length;

    API.updateScene({
      elements: syncInvalidIndices([
        ...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
        API.createElement({ id: "mine" }),
      ]),
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
    });
    sync();

    expect(getSentUpdates().length).toBeGreaterThan(sentBefore);
  });

  it("AC-F: locking and unlocking sends nothing new to other collaborators", () => {
    const emittedBefore = mocks.emitted.length;

    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID);
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    execute("unlockAllCollaborators");
    // what onChange would do after each state change
    sync();

    expect(mocks.emitted.length).toBe(emittedBefore);
  });

  it("AC-F: locking and unlocking change no element versions", () => {
    const before = getVersions();

    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    execute("unlockAllCollaborators");
    sync();

    expect(getVersions()).toEqual(before);
  });

  it("AC-F: a peer's edit to a locked collaborator's element still arrives", async () => {
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");

    await deliver({
      type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
      payload: {
        elements: syncInvalidIndices([
          newElementWith(getElement("theirs"), { x: 500 }),
        ]),
      },
    });

    await waitFor(() => expect(getElement("theirs").x).toBe(500));
  });
});
```

```txt
feat(editor): enforce collaborator lock at interaction chokepoints (#81)

Route every interaction through the single interactivity rule in
element/ownership.ts (not hidden AND not locked; own bucket never
locked). Interaction chokepoints now call `isElementInteractive` /
`excludeNonInteractiveElements` instead of the visibility-only checks:

- hit testing (click select, double-click text edit, path-target pick)
- selectGroupsForSelectedElements (marquee, lasso, select all, groups)
- the App selection safety net, now also re-run on lock changes
- the eraser (candidates and group members)

Rendering, export, search and arrow binding stay visibility-only:
per amended AC-E, arrows may still bind to locked elements.

Tests: blocked interactions with controls (AC-D/E), mixed marquee,
no element versions changed or messages sent on lock/unlock (AC-F,
through the real Collab/Portal), and unit tests for the pure rule.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
